items.text: The latest completed close is 107.90. Support is 107.60 and resistance 109.35. A future completed close above resistance would move beyond the upper reference range; below support would move beyond the lower range.
Price is 2.14% above its 20-session average (105.64); RSI14 is 58.4. Five-session momentum is rising.
Latest daily log-return velocity is +1.59%; it changed +2.15 percentage points from the prior session. Confirmed pivots are separated from the unfinished swing.
Observed daily volume is 0.67 times its 20-session average. Trade-level volume by price is unavailable from these daily inputs.

TSMC comparison benchmark (2330) changed -0.41% over five completed sessions; 0050 changed +0.89%, a difference of +1.30 percentage points. This is a named benchmark comparison, not a sector-flow estimate.

The Rust engine resampled historical five-session return blocks into 5000 seeded trials. The median terminal price is 127.78; the middle half of simulated endpoints spans 115.26–140.88. These paths do not change when a reference level is crossed.
